decks.notes: The deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategies by using removal spells and hand disruption to control the game. It also utilizes creatures that generate value over time, such as Deranged Hermit and Ravenous Baloth, to establish a strong board presence. The deck aims to outlast its opponent by constantly replenishing resources and grinding out incremental advantages until it can seize control and overwhelm the opponent. The combination of removal, disruption, and efficient creatures allows The Rock to gradually wear down its opponent and emerge victorious in the late game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to instantly put a 12/12 creature into play for just one mana. It includes a mix of counterspells, draw spells, and disruption to protect the combo and control the game. Powder Keg provides additional removal, while Mishra's Factory offers a backup win condition. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo, stifle any opposing threats, and overwhelm the opponent with a massive creature before they can react effectively.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with a combination of mana dorks and Gaea's Cradle to power out high-value threats like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. The deck also utilizes Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures like Multani's Acolyte and Quirion Ranger, while also enabling combo pieces like Wirewood Symbiote and Caller of the Claw. The inclusion of Tangle Wire helps to disrupt opponents' game plans while maintaining the aggro pressure. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its fast mana production and resilient threats.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence through aggressive creatures like Terravore and Call of the Herd while disrupting opponents with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Meddling Mage. It aims to control the game by using Armageddon to destroy lands and slow down opponents, while utilizing cards such as Sylvan Library and Weathered Wayfarer to keep card advantage. Additionally, it includes a mix of mana-fixing lands like Rishadan Port and Wasteland to ensure consistent mana production and to disrupt opponent's game plan.

This deck is focused on quickly deploying a horde of aggressive goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to rush the opponent with Goblin Lackey to cheat out powerful goblins early on, supported by cards like Goblin Warchief to reduce costs and increase speed. Gempalm Incinerator provides removal and card draw, while Goblin Ringleader helps refill the hand with more goblins. The deck also includes disruptive lands like Rishadan Port and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow them down, allowing the goblins to deal maximum damage.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat out powerful goblin creatures and cards like Goblin Warchief to reduce their cost, the deck aims to quickly amass a board presence that can deal significant damage in a short amount of time. Additional support cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Siege-Gang Commander provide removal and additional reach, while disruption from cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port can help to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards to maintain advantage. The deck contains a variety of counterspells such as Force Spike, Mana Leak, and Counterspell, as well as removal options like Powder Keg and Chain of Vapor. The inclusion of card draw spells like Fact or Fiction and Impulse helps to ensure a steady stream of resources. With a mix of utility lands and creature lands, the deck can maintain board presence while controlling the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play Phyrexian Dreadnought and use cards like Stifle and Foil to protect it. By utilizing a combination of counter spells and card draw, the deck aims to efficiently control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Chain of Vapor and Misdirection allow for flexibility in dealing with opposing threats. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around efficiently assembling its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck revolves around the strategy of quickly getting elves onto the battlefield to generate mana through abilities like Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with early aggression. Using cards like Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote to untap creatures and maximize mana production, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and overpower the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Additionally, cards like Survival of the Fittest allow for key cards to be tutored up to further enhance the deck's synergy and aggression.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counter spells, removal spells, and board wipes to keep the opponent's threats in check. The deck aims to establish a board presence with lands like Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave while also drawing extra cards with Fact or Fiction and Impulse. Standstill is a key card in this strategy, as it forces the opponent to either stop playing spells or give the control player card advantage. The overall goal is to outlast the opponent and win through attrition.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with enchantments using cards like Attunement and Intuition, then using Replenish to bring them all back into play. The key combo involves using Opalescence to turn all enchantments into creatures, then using Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide to exile all opponent's permanents. Stifle can be used to protect the combo from opposing abilities, while Mana Leak and Swords to Plowshares provide some control and removal. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and difficult to stop combo.

The deck is focused on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing efficient and low-cost threats like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, the deck can deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Ball Lightning and Sulfuric Vortex ensures that the pressure on the opponent is maintained throughout the game. The deck's strategy is to keep the pressure on and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to stall the opponent's game plan by locking down their resources with the Stasis enchantment while taxing their hand size with Black Vise and their ability to cast spells with Propaganda. The deck aims to draw cards and counter key spells while protecting the Stasis lock with counter magic. Utilizing cards like Gush and Impulse to help find the necessary pieces to assemble the lock. The combination of stalling tactics and card advantage allows the player to eventually overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The focus of this deck is on quickly getting out Phyrexian Dreadnought and using Stifle to counter any removal attempts. It utilizes countermagic and card draw to protect and accelerate the combo while also having utility in the form of bounce spells and card selection. The deck aims to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces and win the game through an explosive play.

The deck focuses on utilizing both discard and recursion effects to control the game and outvalue opponents. By using cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress to disrupt their opponent's gameplan and Survival of the Fittest to find key creatures, the player can grind out advantage over time. The inclusion of creatures like Genesis and Graveborn Muse provide additional value, while cards like Recurring Nightmare allow the player to repeatedly recur powerful creatures from the graveyard. The deck aims to outlast opponents with its resource management and card advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence through efficient creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Terravore, while disrupting opponent's strategy with cards like Vindicate and Gerrard's Verdict. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly using Mox Diamond and Weathered Wayfarer, leading up to a devastating Armageddon to wipe out opponent's lands. Sylvan Library helps with card advantage and consistency, while Swords to Plowshares provides removal. The deck's mana base includes a mix of lands that can generate multiple colors of mana, along with Wasteland to disrupt opponent's land base.
